# Supplier Performance Scorecards

## Purpose

Use balanced evidence to review material supplier performance over time.

## Requirements

Scorecards SHOULD consider service quality, incidents, support responsiveness, security/privacy commitments, remediation quality, resilience, delivery, cost/value, and open risk where relevant.

Scores should document limitations and should not hide severe issues inside a favorable aggregate average.
